links.outcome: Consistency of retinal fluid quantification across OCT acquisition devices, by model
links.effect: Task-specific model achieved higher segmentation performance and more consistent fluid quantification across devices than the foundation model; the foundation model was less consistent across devices.
links.quote: The task-specific model achieved higher segmentation performance and more consistent fluid quantification across devices.

links.outcome: Segmentation accuracy of task-specific model versus foundation model on same benchmark data
links.effect: Task-specific RetiFluidNet achieved higher pixel-level segmentation performance than the VisionFM foundation model on 4,248 OCT images using three-fold cross-validation.
links.quote: The task-specific model achieved higher segmentation performance and more consistent fluid quantification across devices.

screen.reason: Compares an ophthalmic foundation model to a task-specific segmentation model on an OCT dataset for retinal fluid segmentation; purely algorithmic performance comparison without testing a deployment practice.
